name: zero-to-one-panda-css
description: Panda CSS v2 curriculum: executable examples, CSS snapshot fixtures, negative extraction fixtures and Playwright computed-style tests

scripts.codegen: panda codegen --cwd examples/react && panda codegen --cwd examples/solid && panda codegen --cwd examples/vanilla && panda codegen --cwd examples/fixtures && panda codegen --cwd examples/monorepo/packages/ds && panda lib --cwd examples/monorepo/packages/ds && panda codegen --cwd examples/monorepo/apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run codegen && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.solid.json
